clock_model.rtl_boundary: clk_i rising edge advances one complete normalized E-cycle when clock_enable_i is high
clock_model.historical_boundary: MC6801 bus and peripheral behavior is specified relative to the internally derived E clock
clock_model.limitation: Port 3 address/data half-cycle multiplexing, AS/E waveforms, setup/hold, and electrical timing require a separate physical-pin wrapper

signals.name: clk_i
signals.fact: one rising edge advances one normalized E-cycle

signals.name: clock_enable_i
signals.fact: low preserves synchronous CPU and peripheral state

signals.name: reset_n_i
signals.fact: active-low reset restores the hardware-selected OPERATING_MODE and begins reset-vector entry

signals.name: nmi_n_i
signals.fact: active-low non-maskable interrupt input

signals.name: irq1_n_i
signals.fact: active-low highest-priority maskable external interrupt input

signals.name: port1_i
signals.fact: physical pin levels returned by PORT1 reads

signals.name: port1_o
signals.fact: latched Port 1 output values

signals.name: port1_oe_o
signals.fact: one enables the corresponding output

signals.name: port2_i
signals.fact: physical pin input for GPIO, timer capture, and SCI

signals.name: port2_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch with timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: port2_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO direction with documented timer and SCI overrides

signals.name: port3_i
signals.fact: GPIO sample in Modes 4/7 and external read data in expanded modes

signals.name: port3_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch in Modes 4/7, write data in expanded modes, and internal read data in Mode 0

signals.name: port3_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO DDR in Modes 4/7 or full-byte normalized data-bus drive

signals.name: port4_i
signals.fact: physical Port 4 input in Modes 4/7

signals.name: port4_o
signals.fact: GPIO latch in Modes 4/7, low address in Mode 5, and high address in Modes 0-3/6

signals.name: port4_oe_o
signals.fact: GPIO/address enable follows the mode and P4DDR where documented

signals.name: program_data_i
signals.fact: integrator-supplied byte for selected normal or relocated 2-KiB ROM windows

signals.name: program_address_o
signals.fact: full CPU address qualified by program_read_o

signals.name: program_read_o
signals.fact: active for internal program reads; Mode 0 excludes only its initial two reset-vector bytes

signals.name: external_data_i
signals.fact: normalized external read byte; also represents sampled unselected Port 3 data in Mode 5

signals.name: external_address_o
signals.fact: full normalized CPU address without half-cycle multiplexing

signals.name: external_data_o
signals.fact: CPU write byte

signals.name: external_write_o
signals.fact: one denotes a CPU write; qualify selected external storage with external_bus_valid_o

signals.name: external_bus_valid_o
signals.fact: selected external transaction; Mode 5 asserts only from 0100 through 01FF and Modes 4/7 never assert

signals.name: external_opcode_fetch_o
signals.fact: qualified external read that fetches an opcode

halt_interrupt_behavior: MC6801 has no external HALT input; WAI and interrupt acceptance are implemented in the CPU profile, while this wrapper selects IRQ1, timer, and SCI vectors at the documented priority boundary
